record_scope_reconstruction: October 2019 order concerns Jhulaghat suspension bridge between Baitadi and Pithoragarh. Daura and other Uttarakhand bridge arrangements are distinct, not extra geometry for this phase.

source_checks.finding: October 5 report identifies Jhulaghat and Daura bridge closures 48 hours before polls; confirms physical bridge identity, not exact reopening.
Official PWD inventory names Jhulaghat pedestrian suspension bridge on Kali River and supplies explicit coordinates; its provisional status retained.
